}}'''Materese the Healer''' is a character in one of the ancient [[stories]] in [[Thom Merrilin|Thom Merrilin's]] repertoire that date to the [[First Age]]. She is also known as the "Mother of the Wondrous Ind".{{ref/book|1|4}}  The story of Materese represents the legend of a real person that has gradually evolved away from the truth and faded into myth.  This is common for all stories that transcend multiple ages as the [[Wheel of Time]] turns.

==Parallels==
Materese is a hidden reference to [[Wikipedia:Mother Teresa|Mother Teresa]] and the Wondrous Ind is a reference to India, where she ministered.
